long_biography.plain_text:
BG Capital Group works as a business and asset consolidator, providing capital and oversight to growth companies while leaving operating teams a degree of autonomy. His earlier public-company investments established the model: as BG Capital's sole shareholder, Genovese used the firm to take controlling stakes and exercise voting authority over portfolio companies.

BG Signature extended the platform into hospitality destinations and equestrian operations. A lifelong rider, Genovese founded Vancouver International Polo and later assembled clubs and training facilities in Canada, Florida and Argentina. He has also chaired car and boat rallies supporting pediatric cancer care through SickKids.
